policies.name: Non-Human Database Access Rules
policies.description: Intercept and block headless actions modifying the production customer database without matching ERP compliance context approval keys.

policies.name: Headless Action Fabric Command Redirection
policies.description: Block all raw SSH, command execution, or bash execution commands triggered inside sandboxed AI agents.

policies.name: Reasoning Standard Alignment V2
policies.description: Continuously monitors cognitive logs via Google AI Studio Native Telemetry. Flag any agent reasoning shifts exceeding 10% from the safe, baseline ethical standards.

policies.name: Demographic Sentiment Fairness
policies.description: Tracks model sentiment variance toward specific demographic filters. Blocks system output if biased language bias occurs.

policies.name: Agentic Session Budget Cap
policies.description: CFO dashboard limit capping any single autonomous session total cost at $50.00 to prevent context-bloated, infinite looping budget burn.

policies.name: API Cost Peak Safeguard
policies.description: Flag or restrict single LLM requests costing more than $5.00 each to prevent extreme model spend spikes.
